selection_contract.selection_rule_after_call: Review the ranked cases in order for safety and contract fitness only. Select the first passing case. Do not inspect or rank for likely mental-model, graph, pressure, or answer-delta value.

non_claims: Synthetic conversations are not evidence of real-world product usefulness.
The generation model does not provide gold reasoning or expected answers.
Mechanical selection does not prove case representativeness.
A safety-passing case is not a favorable Lolla or graph case.
This contract does not authorize Stage A, Stage B, graph ablation, runtime integration, or product claims.
